programme.title: Computer Science and Technology (School of Electronics Engineering and Computer Science)
programme.degree: Bachelor's degree, 4-6 years; admission by school (EECS), major chosen after year 2
programme.how_found: International Students Division site isd.pku.edu.cn: Admission Catalogue + 2026 Undergraduate Program Without Written Examination notice + its 2026 score requirements appendix.
programme.notes: The 2027-entry undergraduate notices for international students were not yet published on 2026-10-19; all answers below are from the 2026-entry notices (academic year 2026/27) and say so.

english.quote: The study duration for undergraduate international students is between 4 to 6 years, with Chinese as the medium of instruction.
english.notes: Chinese-taught; no English test is required. The 2026 score requirements (https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/detail.php?id=816) require 'HSK 6 with score ≥ 210' (or IB HL Chinese 6 / A-Level Chinese A for the IB / A-Level routes). Application materials may be in Chinese or English.

value.description: No GPA threshold; without-written-examination route (2026 entry) needs standardized results: SAT >= 1400 plus three AP >= 4; IB Diploma >= 36 with three HL; A-Level no grade lower than ABB in three relevant subjects; ACT >= 30 with writing; national exams per country (e.g. ATAR >= 90). Information-science applicants must present mathematics results. An entrance-examination route also exists.

gpa.quote: Results from at least three Higher Level (HL) courses; Total score ≥ 36.
gpa.notes: 2026 Score Requirements for Undergraduate Program Without Written Examination; 2027 not yet published.

deadline.quote: Round 1: The online application system will be open from 12:00 on 19 December 2025 (Friday) to 23:59 on 28 February 2026 (Saturday) (all above are Beijing time)
deadline.notes: 2026 ENTRY (September 2026), not 2027: the 2027 notice is not yet published. Round 2 for 2026 entry: '12:00 on 12 June 2026 (Friday) to 23:59 on 10 July 2026 (Friday)'; applicants choose one round. Beijing time. Without-written-examination route.

tuition.notes: The 2026 notice says 'Tuition fee. Further notice will be given after approval.' The 2025-entry notice (https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/detail.php?id=502) said 'Science and Engineering: RMB 30,000 per academic year' - a 2025/26 figure, not recorded as the answer.

value.name: Chinese Government Scholarship; Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students; Peking University Scholarship for International Students

scholarship_exists.quote: Peking University Scholarship for International Students: Exemption form full or partial tuition fees, provision of medical insurance, and monthly payment of living expenses.
scholarship_exists.notes: 2026-entry notice. Beijing Government Scholarship / PKU Scholarship awarded on comprehensive evaluation, no separate application. Beijing Type A: tuition, accommodation, insurance, monthly living expenses. Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A) via the home country's dispatching authority and the CSCA test. All competitive.

scholarship_international.quote: Qualified applicants will be awarded the "Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students" or "Peking University Scholarship for International Students" based on comprehensive evaluation by the school, and there is no need for applicants to apply separately.
